audit.why: Emerald+ 46.68% over 512 games and both charts give Poppy four of seven stages with Jayce holding only Levels 2-3 and Level 6. That is the right shape for a lane where the ranged champion wins the first three minutes and loses everything after armour exists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence is given its own spike row with no cooldown, so 'only when her W is on cooldown' is advice with no timer.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12 — twenty seconds at rank 1, the longest cooldown either champion has in the early lane and longer than Thundering Blow's 20s only ties. That number is the whole matchup: it means the dash-cancel is NOT always available, and a Poppy who spends it has given you a genuine twenty-second window to use To the Skies!. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10 and Hammer Shock 8/7/6/5/4, so her engage is the expensive half and her poke is the cheap half — the same shape as Ornn, and the page reads it the same wrong way.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence 20s at rank 1, Heroic Charge 14s, Hammer Shock 8s — the W is the window, the Q is constant.

audit.whatIsWrong: `spikes[0].text` and `early` say the shred lands on 'each Cannon/Hammer swap' / whenever 'you swap stances', and `wants.you[1]` and `whys[2]` specifically say to 'swap to Hammer for the shred hit'. Both framings are wrong, the second one backwards.
audit.why: Riot: from Hammer Stance the swap becomes Mercury Cannon and 'the first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist'; from Cannon Stance it becomes Mercury Hammer and that first attack 'deals additional magic damage'. Only one of the two directions shreds. Against Poppy this decides the burst: the page's own combo is 'Cannon-Q then swap to Hammer for the Armor/MR-shred hit into Q-E-W', which lands the bonus-magic-damage hit and no shred at all, into a champion whose entire scaling is resistances.
audit.corrected: Only the swap INTO Mercury Cannon shreds; the Hammer-form first hit is bonus magic damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence is described only as a dash-cancel. Riot's first sentence about it — the half that decides your finishing burst — is absent.
audit.why: Riot: 'Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health.' So her resistances go UP exactly as she drops, which directly contradicts the page's repeated instruction to poke her down and then commit ('When she is low, burst with Cannon-Q then swap...'). The lower she is, the worse your burst converts. That is also the strongest argument for the Mercury Cannon shred specifically — stripping an amplified resist is worth more than adding damage — and the page never connects the two.
audit.corrected: Her passive resists rise as her health falls, so a low Poppy is tankier per point of damage — strip with the Cannon attack rather than out-damaging.

audit.why: The claim that Steadfast Presence hard-cancels To the Skies! is right: Riot's text says the active is used to 'stop enemy dashes around her', and Jayce's Hammer Q is flagged as a dash. The Heroic Charge wall-stun description is accurate too — it is a dash that pushes the target, and stuns only if the target hits a wall.

edits.before: Acceleration Gate (E) online: a Shock Blast fired through the gate becomes the long-range accelerated orb, and your first hit after each Cannon/Hammer swap shreds Poppy's Armor and MR every time she walks up to last-hit.
edits.after: Acceleration Gate (E) online: a Shock Blast fired through the gate becomes the long-range accelerated orb, and your first attack after swapping INTO Mercury Cannon shreds Poppy's Armor and MR every time she walks up to last-hit.

edits.before: Steadfast Presence hard-cancels your To-the-Skies (Hammer Q) leap mid-dash and disables your passive ghosting, so never commit a melee gap-close into a raised W - keep poking with gate-Q from range instead.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence (20s at rank 1) hard-cancels your To the Skies! leap mid-dash, and its passive resists RISE as her health falls - so a low Poppy is tankier per point, and spending her W buys you a 20-second window.

edits.before: When she is low, burst with Cannon-Q then swap to Hammer for the Armor/MR-shred hit into Q-E-W before she can wall-stun back
edits.after: Open the burst by swapping INTO Mercury Cannon for the Armor/MR-shred attack - her resists climb as she drops, so strip first

edits.before: Full kit is live - Cannon-Q, swap to Hammer for the shred hit, then Q-E-W bursts her hard before she has tank stats to fight back, your hardest favor window.
edits.after: Full kit is live - Hammer Q-E-W, then swap INTO Mercury Cannon so that attack strips her Armor and MR before she has tank stats, your hardest favor window.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely even - you have only Cannon Q and she trades you straight up, so just gate-Q her walk-ups for chip and last-hit; do not over-extend for a kill that is not there. Levels 2-3 are your real windows: with Acceleration Gate (E) down you fire Shock Blast through the gate for the full-range accelerated orb, and every time she steps up to farm you swap stances so your first hit shreds her Armor and MR. The trap is her W - if you ever go Hammer form and To-the-Skies leap onto her while Steadfast Presence is raised, the dash gets hard-cancelled, so win this lane from range and only swap to melee to finish an already-chunked Poppy.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely even - you have only Cannon Q and she trades you straight up, so gate-Q her walk-ups for chip and last-hit; do not over-extend for a kill that is not there. Levels 2-3 are your real windows: with Acceleration Gate down you fire Shock Blast through the gate for the full-range accelerated orb, and the first attack after you swap INTO Mercury Cannon strips her Armor and MR. The trap is her W - a To the Skies! leap into a raised Steadfast Presence is hard-cancelled outright, but it is 20 seconds at rank 1, so once she burns it the melee window is genuinely open.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. E-knock/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence: 20s at rank 1, cancels your To the Skies! outright, and its passive resists rise as she drops. - Heroic Charge: 14s, 475 range, stuns only into a wall. - Hammer Shock: 8s, constant, never a window.

edits.before: That is Poppy's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Poppy's favourite window — stay off walls and half her win condition is gone.

notes: Two corrections that pull against each other and both need to land together. The page tells you to poke Poppy low and then burst her; Riot's Steadfast Presence passive says her Armor and MR increase as her health falls, so that plan converts worse the closer she gets to dying. The answer is the Mercury Cannon shred — which is the other correction, because four strings had the swap direction wrong or described it as happening on 'each' swap. Only the swap INTO Cannon shreds. The packet's one flagged suspect name, 'Hold Steadfast Presence' in wants.foe[0], is a false positive; the name is exact. I left the `mid` paragraph's 'her tank stats start eating your poke' alone since it is true as written, but it is the third place the low-HP resist ramp would belong.
